name: ui-star-rating-tap
title: Star Rating
description: Bấm vào ngôi sao thứ tư, bốn ngôi sao lần lượt sáng màu nhấn, mỗi ngôi phồng 1.25 rồi về, nhãn hiện 4 / 5.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-feedback-star-rating, written here): Five stars (outer 16 / inner 7 px, 40 px apart), grey. Click on star 4 at 0.68-0.8 s; stars 1-4 light in turn from 0.78 s + 0.08 s each: scale 0.3 → 1 over 0.28 s back.out plus a 0.25 half-sine bump (peak ≈ 1.25). Label '4 / 5' updates as they light. Out 2.3-2.5 s. Params: rating (4) · each (0.08 s) · pop (0.28 s, back.out, tối đa 1.25) · stars (5). The stars light in turn, 0.08 s apart: 0.3 → 1 (back.out) plus a half-sine bump to about 1.25.
moworks.titleVi: Bấm sao, các sao sáng lần lượt
